verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Alloy can generate alerts or investigations when monitoring thresholds are met, and that manual reviews occur as webhook events. Nothing documents assigning cases to analysts or routing them through review and escalation stages. Creating investigations and emitting manual-review events are adjacent features, not the case assignment and stage-routing workflow this story asks for.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met
asynchronous events like when a watchlist gets updated or a manual review occurs
